annotations.title: One place by its GeoNames ID

description: Everything about one place by its GeoNames ID (from find_city or places_near): names in 16 languages, region, country, coordinates, population, elevation and its time zone with the current UTC offset. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

geonameId.description: The GeoNames ID (geonameId in every result).

lang.description: Show names in this language (place, region and country): ar, de, en, es, fr, hi, it, ja, ko, nl, pl, pt, ru, tr, uk or zh ("en-US" works too). Without it, places carry GeoNames' own name (usually the local or international one). Searching always matches every language.
